# Packages

```{r}
# List of required packages
list_of_packages <- c("MASS", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "caret", "rpart", "tidyr", "here", "glmnet" ,"synthpop", "purrr", "MonteCarlo", "tidyverse", "Matrix", "caret", "e1071", "stringr", "tidyr", "bnlearn", "tibble", "gridExtra", "dplyr") #, "kernlab"

# Function to install a package if it is not already installed
install_if_missing <- function(p){
  if(!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)){
    install.packages(p)
  }
  library(p, character.only=TRUE)
}

# Install and load packages
lapply(list_of_packages, install_if_missing)
#library()
```

# Compare prediction metrics

```{r}
compare_pred_results <- function(dataset_name,
                                 target_type = c("classification", "regression"),
                                 save_plot = TRUE) {
  target_type <- match.arg(target_type)
  pred_methods  <- c("parm", "cart", "bn", "svm")
  synth_methods <- c("parmsyn", "cartsyn", "bnsyn", "svmsyn")
  synth_seeds   <- paste0("synmc", 1:5)
 
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    pred_methods <- setdiff(pred_methods, "bn")
    synth_methods <- setdiff(synth_methods, "bnsyn")
  }
 
  pred_colors <- c(
    cartpred = "#82c074",
    bnpred   = "#54bdbf",
    parmpred = "#e9496a",
    svmpred  = "#ed9656"
  )
 
  plot_title <- paste("Prediction performance comparison:", dataset_name)
  plot_filename <- paste0("pred_perf_comp_", dataset_name, ".png")
  plot_path <- file.path(figure_dir, plot_filename)
 
  # load original results
  orig_list <- lapply(pred_methods, function(pred_method) {
    file_path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_orig_", pred_method, ".RData"))
    if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
      message("Original file not found: ", file_path)
      return(NULL)
    }
    obj_name <- load(file_path)
    obj <- get(obj_name)
    rm(list = obj_name)
 
    obj %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        data_type = "original",
        synth_method = "original",
        synth_seed = NA_character_,
        pred_method = pred_method
      )
  })
 
  orig_df <- bind_rows(orig_list)
 
  # load synthetic results
  syn_list <- list()
 
  for (synth_method in synth_methods) {
    for (synth_seed in synth_seeds) {
      for (pred_method in pred_methods) {
        file_path <- file.path(
          data_dir,
          paste0(dataset_name, "_", synth_method, "_", synth_seed, "_", pred_method, "pred.RData")
        )
 
        if (!file.exists(file_path)) next
 
        obj_name <- load(file_path)
        obj <- get(obj_name)
        rm(list = obj_name)
 
        syn_list[[paste(synth_method, synth_seed, pred_method, sep = "_")]] <- obj %>%
          mutate(
            dataset = dataset_name,
            data_type = "synthetic",
            synth_method = synth_method,
            synth_seed = synth_seed,
            pred_method = pred_method
          )
      }
    }
  }
 
  syn_df <- bind_rows(syn_list)
  all_df <- bind_rows(orig_df, syn_df)
 
  id_cols <- c("dataset", "data_type", "synth_method", "synth_seed", "pred_method")
  metric_cols <- setdiff(names(all_df), id_cols)
 
  synth_levels <- c("original", "parmsyn", "cartsyn", "bnsyn", "svmsyn")
  synth_labels <- c(
    original = "original data",
    parmsyn  = "param. syn.",
    cartsyn  = "CART syn.",
    bnsyn    = "BN syn.",
    svmsyn   = "SVM syn."
  )
 
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    synth_levels <- c("original", "parmsyn", "cartsyn", "svmsyn")
    synth_labels <- synth_labels[synth_levels]
  }
 
  plot_df <- all_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(metric_cols),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pred_method_plot = factor(
        paste0(pred_method, "pred"),
        levels = c("parmpred", "cartpred", "bnpred", "svmpred")
      ),
      synth_method = factor(
        synth_method,
        levels = synth_levels,
        labels = synth_labels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
 
  metric_ranges <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    summarise(
      ymin = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(
      synth_method = factor(synth_labels, levels = synth_labels),
      pred_method_plot = levels(plot_df$pred_method_plot)
    )
 
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = pred_method_plot, y = value, color = pred_method_plot)
  ) +
    geom_blank(
      data = metric_ranges,
      aes(x = pred_method_plot, y = ymin),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_blank(
      data = metric_ranges,
      aes(x = pred_method_plot, y = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.24,
      height = 0,
      size = 2.2,
      alpha = 1,
      shape = 16
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      metric ~ synth_method,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = pred_colors,
      name = "Prediction method"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Metric value"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.9, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.9, "lines")
    )
 
  if (save_plot) {
    if (!dir.exists(figure_dir)) {
      dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
 
    ggsave(
      filename = plot_path,
      plot = p,
      width = 12,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
 
  list(
    all_data = all_df,
    plot_data = plot_df,
    plot = p,
    plot_path = if (save_plot) plot_path else NA_character_
  )
}
```

# Compare reinforcement ratio

```{r}
compute_reinforcement_real <- function(dataset_name,
                                       target_type = c("classification", "regression"),
                                       save_plot = TRUE) {
  target_type <- match.arg(target_type)
  higher_better <- c("Accuracy", "F1", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "R_squared")
  lower_better  <- c("RMSE", "MAE")
  pred_methods  <- c("parm", "cart", "bn", "svm")
  synth_methods <- c("parmsyn", "cartsyn", "bnsyn", "svmsyn")
  synth_seeds   <- paste0("synmc", 1:5)
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    synth_methods <- setdiff(synth_methods, "bnsyn")
  }
  family_from_model <- function(x) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      str_detect(x, "^cart") ~ "cart",
      str_detect(x, "^svm")  ~ "svm",
      str_detect(x, "^parm") ~ "parm",
      str_detect(x, "^bn")   ~ "bn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  }
  family_palette <- c(
    cart = "#82c074",
    bn   = "#54bdbf",
    parm = "#e9496a",
    svm  = "#ed9656"
  )
  family_labels <- c(
    parm = "Parametric Syn.",
    cart = "CART Syn.",
    bn   = "BN Syn.",
    svm  = "SVM Syn."
  )
  family_order <- c("parm", "cart", "bn", "svm")
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    family_order <- setdiff(family_order, "bn")
    family_labels <- family_labels[family_order]
  }
  # ----------------------------
  # load original results
  # ----------------------------
  orig_list <- lapply(pred_methods, function(pred_method) {
    file_path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_orig_", pred_method, ".RData"))
    if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
      message("Original file not found: ", file_path)
      return(NULL)
    }
    obj_name <- load(file_path)
    obj <- get(obj_name)
    rm(list = obj_name)
    obj %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        data_type = "original",
        synth_method = NA_character_,
        synth_seed = NA_character_,
        Prediction_Model = paste0(pred_method, "pred")
      )
  })
  orig_df <- bind_rows(orig_list)
  # ----------------------------
  # load synthetic results
  # ----------------------------
  syn_list <- list()
  for (synth_method in synth_methods) {
    for (synth_seed in synth_seeds) {
      for (pred_method in pred_methods) {
        file_path <- file.path(
          data_dir,
          paste0(dataset_name, "_", synth_method, "_", synth_seed, "_", pred_method, "pred.RData")
        )
        if (!file.exists(file_path)) next
        obj_name <- load(file_path)
        obj <- get(obj_name)
        rm(list = obj_name)
        syn_list[[paste(synth_method, synth_seed, pred_method, sep = "_")]] <- obj %>%
          mutate(
            dataset = dataset_name,
            data_type = "synthetic",
            synth_method = synth_method,
            synth_seed = synth_seed,
            Prediction_Model = paste0(pred_method, "pred"),
            Synthesis_Model = synth_method
          )
      }
    }
  }
  syn_df <- bind_rows(syn_list)
  # ----------------------------
  # combine and pivot long
  # ----------------------------
  all_df <- bind_rows(orig_df, syn_df)
  id_cols <- c(
    "dataset", "data_type", "synth_method", "synth_seed",
    "Prediction_Model", "Synthesis_Model"
  )
  metric_cols <- setdiff(names(all_df), id_cols)
  long_df <- all_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(metric_cols),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    mutate(
      TargetType = ifelse(target_type == "regression", "Continuous", "Categorical"),
      Synth_Family = family_from_model(Synthesis_Model),
      Pred_Family  = family_from_model(Prediction_Model)
    )
  # remove BN cases for regression
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    long_df <- long_df %>%
      filter(Pred_Family != "bn") %>%
      filter(Synth_Family != "bn" | is.na(Synth_Family))
  }
  # ----------------------------
  # relative-to-best within original and synthetic
  # ----------------------------
  orig_rel <- long_df %>%
    filter(data_type == "original") %>%
    group_by(dataset, Metric) %>%
    mutate(
      best_val = case_when(
        Metric %in% higher_better ~ max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
        Metric %in% lower_better  ~ min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      rel_orig = case_when(
        Metric %in% higher_better ~ Value / best_val,
        Metric %in% lower_better  ~ best_val / Value,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(dataset, Metric, Pred_Family, Prediction_Model, rel_orig)
  synth_rel <- long_df %>%
    filter(data_type == "synthetic") %>%
    group_by(dataset, synth_method, synth_seed, Metric) %>%
    mutate(
      best_val = case_when(
        Metric %in% higher_better ~ max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
        Metric %in% lower_better  ~ min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      rel_synth = case_when(
        Metric %in% higher_better ~ Value / best_val,
        Metric %in% lower_better  ~ best_val / Value,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(dataset, synth_method, synth_seed, Metric,
           Synth_Family, Pred_Family, Prediction_Model, rel_synth)
  # ----------------------------
  # keep same-family synthetic only
  # ----------------------------
  synth_same <- synth_rel %>%
    filter(Synth_Family == Pred_Family)
  # ----------------------------
  # join with original and compute reinforcement
  # ----------------------------
  reinforce <- synth_same %>%
    left_join(
      orig_rel %>% dplyr::select(dataset, Metric, Pred_Family, rel_orig),
      by = c("dataset", "Metric", "Pred_Family")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Reinforcement = rel_synth / rel_orig
    )
  # average over synthetic seeds
  reinforce_avg <- reinforce %>%
    group_by(dataset, Metric, Synth_Family) %>%
    summarise(
      Reinforcement = mean(Reinforcement, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Synth_Family = factor(Synth_Family, levels = family_order)
    )
  # plot function
  plot_reinforcement <- function(metric_name) {
  df_sub <- reinforce %>%
    filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(
      Synth_Family = factor(Synth_Family, levels = family_order)
    )
 
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        labs(title = NULL) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }
 
  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = Synth_Family, y = Reinforcement, color = Synth_Family)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.2, alpha = 1, shape = 16) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = family_palette[family_order],
      breaks = family_order,
      labels = family_labels[family_order],
      name = "Synthesis model"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = family_labels[family_order]) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = "R"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
 
  if (save_plot) {
    if (!dir.exists(figure_dir)) {
      dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
 
    plot_filename <- paste0("reinf_", dataset_name, "_", metric_name, ".png")
    plot_path <- file.path(figure_dir, plot_filename)
 
    ggsave(
      filename = plot_path,
      plot = p,
      width = 8,
      height = 6,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
 
  p
}
  list(
    long_data = long_df,
    reinforce = reinforce,
    reinforce_avg = reinforce_avg,
    plot_metric = plot_reinforcement
  )
}
```

# Rank Metrics

```{r}
safe_cor <- function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
 
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(x[ok])) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(y[ok])) < 2) return(NA_real_)
 
  tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = method)),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}
 
compute_ranking_real <- function(long_df, target_type = c("classification", "regression")) {
 
  target_type <- match.arg(target_type)
 
  higher_better <- c("Accuracy", "F1", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "R_squared")
  lower_better  <- c("RMSE", "MAE")
 
  family_from_model <- function(x) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(x, "^cart") ~ "cart",
      stringr::str_detect(x, "^svm")  ~ "svm",
      stringr::str_detect(x, "^parm") ~ "parm",
      stringr::str_detect(x, "^bn")   ~ "bn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  }
 
  rank_df <- long_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pred_Family = family_from_model(Prediction_Model),
      Synth_Family = family_from_model(Synthesis_Model)
    )
 
  if (target_type == "regression") {
    rank_df <- rank_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(Pred_Family != "bn") %>%
      dplyr::filter(Synth_Family != "bn" | is.na(Synth_Family))
  }
 
  # ----------------------------
  # Original rankings
  # ----------------------------
 
  orig_rank <- rank_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(data_type == "original") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dataset, Metric) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rank_orig = dplyr::case_when(
        dplyr::first(Metric) %in% higher_better ~ rank(-Value, ties.method = "average"),
        dplyr::first(Metric) %in% lower_better  ~ rank(Value, ties.method = "average"),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      best_rank_orig = min(rank_orig, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_orig = rank_orig == best_rank_orig
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dataset,
      Metric,
      Prediction_Model,
      Pred_Family,
      value_orig = Value,
      rank_orig,
      best_orig
    )
 
  # ----------------------------
  # Synthetic rankings
  # ----------------------------
 
  synth_rank <- rank_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(data_type == "synthetic") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dataset, synth_method, synth_seed, Synth_Family, Metric) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rank_synth = dplyr::case_when(
        dplyr::first(Metric) %in% higher_better ~ rank(-Value, ties.method = "average"),
        dplyr::first(Metric) %in% lower_better  ~ rank(Value, ties.method = "average"),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      best_rank_synth = min(rank_synth, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_synth = rank_synth == best_rank_synth
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dataset,
      synth_method,
      synth_seed,
      Synth_Family,
      Metric,
      Prediction_Model,
      Pred_Family,
      value_synth = Value,
      rank_synth,
      best_synth
    )
 
  # ----------------------------
  # Compare rankings
  # ----------------------------
 
  rank_compare <- synth_rank %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      orig_rank,
      by = c(
        "dataset",
        "Metric",
        "Prediction_Model",
        "Pred_Family"
      )
    )
 
  ranking_metrics <- rank_compare %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      dataset,
      synth_method,
      synth_seed,
      Synth_Family,
      Metric
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      top1_agreement =
        any(best_orig & best_synth, na.rm = TRUE),
 
      synthetic_best_is_same_family =
        any(best_synth & Pred_Family == Synth_Family, na.rm = TRUE),
 
      original_best_is_synth_family =
        any(best_orig & Pred_Family == Synth_Family, na.rm = TRUE),
 
      spearman_rho =
        safe_cor(rank_orig, rank_synth, method = "spearman"),
 
      kendall_tau =
        safe_cor(rank_orig, rank_synth, method = "kendall"),
 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
 
  ranking_summary <- ranking_metrics %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      dataset,
      synth_method,
      Synth_Family,
      Metric
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      top1_agreement = mean(top1_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
      synthetic_best_is_same_family = mean(synthetic_best_is_same_family, na.rm = TRUE),
      original_best_is_synth_family = mean(original_best_is_synth_family, na.rm = TRUE),
      spearman_rho = mean(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),
      kendall_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
 
  list(
    rank_compare = rank_compare,
    ranking_metrics = ranking_metrics,
    ranking_summary = ranking_summary
  )
}


datasets <- c("Adult", "BankMarketing", "BikeSharing", "GermanCredit")
 
target_types <- c(
  Adult         = "classification",
  BankMarketing = "classification",
  BikeSharing  = "regression",
  GermanCredit = "classification"
)
 
all_ranking_real <- purrr::map_dfr(datasets, function(ds) {
 
  reinf_res <- compute_reinforcement_real(
    dataset_name = ds,
    target_type  = target_types[[ds]],
    save_plot    = FALSE
  )
 
  rank_res <- compute_ranking_real(
    long_df      = reinf_res$long_data,
    target_type  = target_types[[ds]]
  )
 
  rank_res$ranking_summary
})
```
